candidate_policy: within each DS1 group, enable exactly the iteration24 eligible sources whose complete cross-fit gate passed; use each enabled source's frozen iteration23 full-TRAIN +/-1 s/hour diagnostic rate; set every other group source exactly to zero
coordinate_policy: reuse each iteration23 group's fixed latitude, longitude, and tau exactly; do not optimize or search geography or time
mask_policy: membership, rates, coordinates, tau, CFO-fitting procedure, controls, diagnostics, gates, and decision are fixed before this run; fit one CFO per track from TRAIN rows only, then score the already-randomized HELD rows once for the admitted candidate; HELD cannot alter any model choice
comparators: iteration23 zero-rate arm at the same fixed coordinate and tau
iteration23 all-source +/-0.25 s/hour arm at the same fixed coordinate and tau
iteration23 all-source +/-1 s/hour arm at the same fixed coordinate and tau

loss.track_metric: squared RMS divided by 800 Hz squared and capped at 1
loss.session_weighting: occupied-second weights, with unsupported weight fixed at cap
loss.group_metric: equal mean of the six session capped losses
loss.pooled_metric: equal mean of all twelve session capped losses

predeclared_gate.exact_replay: candidate direct causal SGP4 and quartic surrogate differ by at most 0.2 Hz
predeclared_gate.per_group_superiority: in each group, candidate HELD equal-session capped loss is strictly below zero-rate, all-source +/-0.25, and all-source +/-1
predeclared_gate.pooled_superiority: candidate pooled HELD equal-session capped loss is strictly below zero-rate, all-source +/-0.25, and all-source +/-1
predeclared_gate.session_breadth: in each group at least four of six sessions have candidate-minus-zero HELD capped loss strictly below zero
predeclared_gate.session_regression_guard: no session has candidate-minus-zero HELD capped loss greater than 0.05
predeclared_gate.decision: justify designing, but not running, a separately sealed prospective geographic basin only if every gate passes

required: equal-session TRAIN and HELD capped losses
per-session HELD changes against every comparator
enabled-source, enabled-track, TRAIN-observation, HELD-observation, and occupied-second support
NORAD 68739 support and exact leave-68739-at-zero sensitivity reconstructed from candidate and zero-rate track scores
worked, failed, learned, and precise next step

sensitivity_policy: NORAD 68739 is diagnostic only and cannot change the candidate, gate, or decision; reconstruct its zeroed sensitivity exactly by replacing its candidate track contributions with the sealed iteration23 zero-rate track contributions, without another HELD model score
